newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks end higher after quiet session.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks end higher after quiet session.

text.p: * Toronto stocks ended higher after a quiet session on Wednesday, buoyed by strong oils and industrials. * 90.5 million shares traded worth C$1.29 billion. * Advances outnumbered declines 476 to 445.
Toronto's key stock index ended higher after a quiet session on Wednesday, buoyed by strong oils and industrials.
The TSE 300 Index climbed 18.76 points to close at 5874.13 in turnover of 90.52 million shares worth C$1.29 billion. Advances outpaced declines 476 to 445, with 310 issues flat.
"There wasn't a whole lot going on. There was big volume in some select groups," said one trader.
Bre-X Minerals Ltd regained the spotlight after news of increased involvement by Indonesia's reigning family in the Calgary prospector's Indonesian deposit.
Bre-X shares closed up 1.22 at 3.62 on turnover of more than 17 million shares and analysts predicted more volatility for Bre-X shares this week.

Ten of Toronto's 14 sub-indexes rose, led by oils and industrials. The energy group gained 66.04 points or 1.05 percent to 6360.33, while industrial products rose 27.11 points or 0.69 percent to 3940.16.
Real estate, communications, golds and conglomerates ended the session in negative territory.
The closing bell marked the last day of floor trading at the TSE, as the exchange switched its final group of stocks to computerized trading.
